status: additive visual-binding contract, not production runtime acceptance
base_commit_scope: verified first delivery only; does not assert this patch already published

replacement_rules.with: pending for uncompleted/queued/flying; complete for receipt check and exhausted
no standalone ring; pending white frame conveys uncompleted
52px badge; never draw old28px check underneath

scope_exclusions: Do not globally replace old blank card file: other consumers remain unchanged
Keep order_trial_card_blank and add-slot/locked layers and entitlement unchanged
Do not alter any target bottle texture or color; retain all eight exact colors
No QA/source imagegen/keyframe screenshot is a runtime asset

geometry.adapter: Place through actual order_card/order_anchor/receiving_anchor/receiving_scale in production1080; transform all local layers together, never independently stretch target or badge. Source anchors are not authoritative production slots.

active_pending.when: existing slot has an active uncompleted order, including queued or receipt flight not yet arrived
active_pending.target: actual current order bottle, alpha1, exact color

receipt_complete_mark.when: existing flight completion enters actual check stage
receipt_complete_mark.target: preserve current actual order target until existing clear/replace stage changes it; alpha1
receipt_complete_mark.animation: optional one-shot frame crossfade/badge pop within existing check duration; do not prolong check or delay queue

receipt_replace.when: existing check ends and real queue provides next order
receipt_replace.frame: pending for newly bound next order
receipt_replace.target: next actual queue order only; no random or invented target
reset: clear completed visual identity before drawing new order

order_slot_exhausted.when: existing check ends, no next order, actual slot enters persistent completed empty state
order_slot_exhausted.target: hide target only when authoritative existing slot is empty; never retain invented prior order or create a new order
order_slot_exhausted.animation: static completed state; no repeat badge pop on every redraw/resume
order_slot_exhausted.meaning: persistent completed empty slot, distinct from transient receipt_complete_mark

restored_or_reduced_motion.render: derive frame/badge directly from actual stage; do not replay historical completion

undo_or_state_rollback.when: authoritative model/display returns to earlier stage
undo_or_state_rollback.render: cancel obsolete visual tween and rederive pending/check/exhausted and actual target from restored state

event_ownership.count: Completion counter reads actual completed/required; visible badge cannot increment or infer it
event_ownership.receipt_timing: Existing flight arrival owns display_delivered update; visual adapter never performs the update
event_ownership.slot_fifo: Keep existing per-slot FIFO and independent slots; no early replacement

animation_guard.key: host actual receipt/order identity plus stage transition; no guessed API required
animation_guard.timing_authority: These are art suggestions only. Fit/clamp/skip within existing check phase; never replace production transaction times
animation_guard.cancel: cancel on slot replacement, undo, restart, exit, or stale receipt; no state mutation

required_acceptance: Pending white frame vs gold/check recognizable at360
Transient check then next order returns white and no badge
No-next-order remains gold+badge empty slot without fake target
Production1080 anchors and receiving foreground clipping verified
